description: New Jersey motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in New Jersey?
questions.explanation: New Jersey helmet law: all riders and passengers.
questions.remember: New Jersey helmets: all riders and passengers.

questions.q: What does New Jersey law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
questions.explanation: New Jersey: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.
questions.remember: New Jersey between lanes: not allowed.

provenance.manual: NJ HTS Motorcycle Proper Training brochure

questions.q: What does New Jersey require for a motorcycle rider's eye protection?
options: Required unless the motorcycle has a windshield
questions.explanation: New Jersey: eye protection is required unless the motorcycle has a windshield.
questions.remember: New Jersey eyewear: required unless there is a windshield.

questions.q: In New Jersey, what is the youngest age for a motorcycle learner's permit?
questions.explanation: New Jersey issues a motorcycle permit at 17 years at the earliest.
questions.remember: New Jersey motorcycle permit: 17 years at the earliest.

provenance.manual: New Jersey Driver Manual (chapter 10, Motorcycle Manual)
